title: ICE Officer Fatally Shoots Mexican National During Houston Traffic Stop
detail: An ICE officer shot and killed Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, 52, a Mexican national who had lived in the US for roughly 35 years, during a vehicle stop in Houston's Second Ward. ICE said Salgado Araujo tried to ram an agent with his vehicle and refused commands; his family disputed the account, saying he was on his way to work and in the process of obtaining a legal work permit. The incident drew scrutiny from elected officials and civil rights groups amid a string of fatal ICE encounters nationally that week.

media.caption: ICE officer fatally shoots Lorenzo Salgado Araujo during a Houston traffic stop

title: Trump Attends 36th NATO Summit in Ankara, Turkey
detail: NATO's 36th summit was held in Ankara on July 7-8, with leaders from all 32 member states attending. President Trump met with allied leaders amid friction over his prior criticisms of the alliance and concerns about cohesion, describing the gathering as showing unity and praising members' progress toward defense-spending targets. The summit concluded with a Trump press conference on July 8.

media.caption: Trump and NATO leaders meet in Ankara, Turkiye as defence spending tops the agenda
